audienceResults.reason: The opening line told me nothing, but I stayed because 'three mistakes' promised a list I could act on. Programme hopping and not tracking are exactly my problems, so I saved it. I would not send this to anyone — there is no single line worth quoting.
I was watching muted and there was no text on screen for the first few seconds, so I had no idea what this was about. I swiped before the first mistake was even named.
Static shot, slow voice, and the first sentence is just throat-clearing. Nothing happened, so I was gone before he said anything real.
I gave it a few seconds because the tone felt calm and not intimidating, but it took too long to tell me what I would get out of it and I moved on.
None of the three mistakes needed a gym, which is rare. Tracking and under-eating apply to me exactly. I saved it and I would probably comment asking about home substitutions.

propagationWaves.note: Seed audience. Retention past 3s is the limiting factor, not distribution.
Reached almost entirely through saves rather than shares, which propagate far more weakly.
Cascade dies. College Gym Starters is the natural amplifier for this niche and it never engaged, so there is nothing to carry the reel outward.

bottlenecks.description: Four out of five personas made their decision before the first mistake was named. The 4.2s hook is longer than the attention budget of every persona in College Gym Starters.
bottlenecks.likelyCause: The opening line ('something a lot of people get wrong') states a category, not a stake. It defers the payoff past the point where the fastest-swiping segment has already left.

bottlenecks.description: The reel converts through saves, not shares. Saves do not propagate, so the cascade terminates at wave 2.
bottlenecks.likelyCause: There is no single quotable or arguable claim. College Gym Starters shares content that starts an argument in a group chat; a calm three-item list gives them nothing to forward.

bottlenecks.description: Muted viewers get no on-screen text until 4.2s.
bottlenecks.likelyCause: Captions are not burned in over the hook, so a viewer watching without sound cannot tell what the reel is about during the exact window in which they decide.

warnings.message: Only 5 personas were simulated. Segment-level confidence is limited, especially for Budget Home Trainees (1 persona).
This result is a development fixture, not a model output.
